GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (12 Feb 47) LS
(SCAPIN - 1524)
APO 500
12 February 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Temporary Release of Detained Suspected War Criminal.
1. The following named Japanese, presently interned in Sugamo Prison as a Suspected War Criminal, will be escorted by an authorized member of the Japanese Police from Sugamo Prison to his home at 2210, 2-Chome Sanno, Omori-ku, Tokyo, Japan, for the purpose of visiting his wife who is seriously ill.
NAME RANK DATE OF INTERNMENT
NEMOTO, Ryiochi Capt. 24 June 1946
2. NEMOTO will be adequately guarded during his absence from Sugamo Prison and will be returned to Sugamo Prison for reincarceration within two days from the date of his1 release.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
